title: The Skybridge Chronicles
logline: Veya the cartographer must unite rival enclaves before Aetheria's skybridges collapse and the floating isles drift apart.
theme: cooperation in the face of loss

scenes.title: Veya Discovers the Collapse
scenes.summary: At Silverspine Academy, Veya's measurements reveal a skybridge route is vanishing.

scenes.title: Kael Closes the Docks
scenes.summary: Kael raises skybridge tolls, sparking protests.
scenes.outcome: The Drift Cartel tightens its grip.

scenes.title: Maris Finds a Secret Route
scenes.summary: Maris reveals a hidden grain path that bypasses the toll.
scenes.outcome: They escape, but Kael now hunts them.

scenes.title: The Bridge Battle
scenes.summary: Veya, Maris and Kael clash atop a fracturing skybridge.
scenes.conflict: Kael would rather rule the ruins than save the realm.
scenes.outcome: Kael's ledger is destroyed; he flees.

scenes.title: The First Shared Map
scenes.summary: The enclaves pool knowledge and begin a new chart of the drift.
